raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

In an environment where accountability fuels innovation and trust is earned through action, this opportunity places a senior technical leader at the center of transforming how customers, partners, and teams connect in an AI-ready future. This leader will help with enterprise solutions, driving meaningful impact through bold thinking, technical excellence, and a commitment to delivering results.
As a Principal Software Development Engineer, this individual serves as a strategic force behind Salesforce innovation and MuleSoft-powered enterprise integrations. By translating complex business needs into scalable technology solutions, they influence how systems, people, and processes work together across the organization. Their expertise helps establish the practices, frameworks, and engineering standards that guide both current initiatives and future transformation efforts.
This role plays a pivotal part in defining software architecture and advancing API-first connectivity across the enterprise. Through technical leadership, this individual designs and enables secure, reusable, and scalable integration patterns that connect Salesforce, internal platforms, and external partner ecosystems. Acting as the engineering authority for cross-system automation, they drive modern integration strategies spanning API design, orchestration, and event-driven architectures that accelerate business outcomes and create lasting value.
Success in this role comes from a combination of technical depth, strategic vision, and leadership through change. The ideal candidate brings experience delivering complex solutions in fast-paced environments, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining a focus on quality, scale, and execution. By partnering closely with business stakeholders and engineering teams, this leader helps guide innovation from concept to reality, shaping technology decisions that strengthen the organization's future and elevate the customer experience.

Location

This is a work from home position within the US.

The Main Responsibilities

Teamwork 

  • Collaborate across Lumen and demonstrate leadership with a high level of engagement and ensuring customer focus with user communities, both internal and external
  • Communication through Interaction with leadership to ensure open communication and handle situations involving conflict while promoting a positive company image

Automation and AI

  • Strongly drive an intentional automation first approach and leverage AI daily to improve efficiency to deliver
  • Incorporate AI to deliver solutions and deliver AI enabled solutions

Software Engineering

  • Lead the design and implementation of MuleSoft-based integrations using API-led connectivity principles and define and govern enterprise API standards, including RAML/OpenAPI specifications, versioning, and lifecycle management
  • DesigAct as a bridge between engineering teams, ensuring that system interactions are clearly defined and consistently implemented
  • and optimize system-to-system integrations across Salesforce, cloud platforms, and on‑prem systems using MuleSoft
  • Ensure reliability, scalability, observability, and security of integrations, including error handling, retries, and monitoring
  • Partner with platform, infrastructure, and security teams to align MuleSoft integrations with enterprise architecture standards and design, development of interactions between distributed systems, and services
  • Define and document using engineering-level design patterns, including data exchange formats, API contracts, and automation triggers and collaborate with infrastructure, platform, and broader software teams to ensure alignment and clarity in system integration
  • Establish and enforce engineering standards for development, design, documentation, and validation
  • Serve as the engineering authority for cross-system automation and integration patterns involving SalesForce

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • BS/BA or equivalent education and experience
  • Strong software development skills surrounding SalesForce
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and delivering integrations using MuleSoft
  • Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams in a complex environment
  • Excellent communication skills to include: verbal, written, and presentation
  • US Citizen or GC holder

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years of experience engineering SaaS / cloud-native / cloud-ready concepts, systems integration, APIs, network technology and operations, or automation architecture
  • Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including API Manager, Runtime Manager, and CloudHub
  • Experience designing API-led connectivity (System, Process, and Experience APIs)
  • Familiarity with tools like common IDEs, automated test suites, CI/CD Pipelines, IaC, Swagger/OpenAPI, BPMN, or UML for documenting system interactions
  • Experience with service orchestration platforms or workflow engines (e.g., Temporal, Camunda, Step Functions)
  • Background in software development, systems engineering, technical architecture, or platform engineering

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION:

As a Sr Account Manager in the Clinical Trials Division at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will drive revenue growth by identifying, developing, and managing business opportunities with Biotech customers across our diverse portfolio of Clinical Trial Supply products and solutions. You will build strong relationships with new and existing customers, understand their clinical development programs and supply chain requirements, and develop tailored solutions that support the successful execution of their clinical trials.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to Biotech customers, using your understanding of clinical development, clinical trial supply, and consultative selling to identify customer needs and build solutions that address complex trial requirements. You will collaborate with technical specialists, operational teams, product managers, and other internal partners to develop and deliver comprehensive clinical trial supply solutions that enable customers to advance their drug development programs and ultimately make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of B2B sales or business development experience in life sciences, biotech, pharmaceutical, clinical trials, or related industries
    • Preferred Fields of Study: Life Sciences, Chemistry, Engineering, Business, or related field
    • Additional business or commercial certifications valued
    • Technical aptitude and ability to understand clinical development programs, clinical trial supply requirements, and complex customer workflows
    • Demonstrated success in consistently meeting/exceeding sales targets, developing new business, and growing strategic Biotech accounts
    • Excellence in consultative and solution selling, relationship building, and negotiations at all levels
    • Ability to identify customer needs and coordinate internal expertise to develop tailored clinical trial supply solutions
    • Experience with CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) and MS Office suite
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across commercial, technical, and operational teams
    • Strong analytical, planning, and organizational abilities
    • Effective presentation and communication skills at all organizational levels, including senior customer stakeholders
    • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 30–40% as needed
    • Fluency in English required; additional language skills valued for international roles
    • Demonstrates commitment to Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement
    • Experience in clinical trial supplies, clinical development services, pharmaceutical services, and/or regulated environments preferred
    • Ability to manage complex, solution-based sales cycles and multiple business development opportunities simultaneously

raw.description:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.

Position Summary

The Revenue Specialist acts as the liaison between key client contacts and insurance companies. This position is responsible for handling patient health information (PHI) and maintaining extreme privacy and security as it relates to confidential and proprietary information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze and evaluate worker’s compensation claim payments using EnableComp’s proprietary software, systems and tools. Use payment documentation provided by payers to determine if the medical provider has been reimbursed in compliance with the applicable state worker’s compensation fee schedule and/or PPO contract.
  • Research, request and acquire all pertinent medical records, implant manufacturer’s invoices and any other supporting documentation necessary and then submit with hospital claims to insurance companies to ensure prompt correct claims reimbursement.
  • Conduct timely and thorough telephone follow-up with payers to ensure claims with supporting documentation have been received and facilitate prompt reimbursement.
  • Prepare correct Workers’ Comp initial bill packet or appeal letter using EnableComp systems tools and submit with all necessary supporting documentation to insurance companies
  • Other duties as required.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required. Associates or Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • 1-2+ years’ experience in healthcare field working in billing or collections.
  • 1+ years’ client facing/customer services experience.
  • 1+ years’ experience with workers compensation billing and collections a preferred.
  • Intermediate level understanding of insurance payer/provider claims processing and subsequent data requirements.
  • Must have strong computer proficiency and understand how to use basic office applications, including MS Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Regular and predictable attendance.

Special Considerations and Prerequisites

  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.
  • Proven ability to meet and/or exceed productivity targets and goals.
  • Maintains stable performance under pressure or opposition. Handles stress in ways to maintain relationships with all stakeholders.
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work independently without direct supervision.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Proven experience working with external clients; strong customer service skills and business acumen.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple competing priorities and projects concurrently.
  • Must be able to remain in stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Occasionally moves about inside the office to access office equipment, etc.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office equipment such as a copy/scan/print machine, phone and computer.
EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. Community Manager - English (Anime & UK Culture Knowledge)

Location: UK

Language: Native English Speaker

Availability: 5 hours per week (on average), with some weeks busier than others due to deadlines and project needs

Overview:
We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew

As a Community Manager, you will work closely with the project management team, client contacts, and the wider group of social and community managers across the business to support internal and client objectives.

Our client is a subscription video-on-demand streaming service that distributes primarily East Asian media, including anime and manga.

We are seeking a social media professional with a proven track record of translating, trans-creating, and localizing content for social and community posting to support strategic planning and operational delivery.

As a ModSquad Community Manager, you will be imperative in building, maintaining, improving, and empowering our clients and their digital communities. Additionally, you will play an important role in the growing ModSquad digital team, developing social media efforts to grow and support our company.

What You’ll Do

The day-to-day tasks of a ModSquad Community Manager and Strategist vary, but basic responsibilities may include:

  • Work closely, efficiently, and effectively with the client and internal teams (communication is daily)
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to deliver strategic and operational goals
  • Design and execute weekly and quarterly content calendars and strategy plans
  • Brainstorm activities, opportunities, and content to inspire or grow community (long term and campaign based)
  • Create and report KPIs to the development team, and build reports that showcase performance, trends, and opportunities
  • Manage and respond to customers through forums, websites, and social media tools, including native and third-party platforms
  • Learn and explore new tools and platforms that improve workflow and client objectives
  • Develop practices and improvements, or build upon and help improve current methods of operation, including social media management, community management, social ROI, engagement, content moderation, and digital experience
  • Handle occasional community crises or troubleshoot escalations
  • Translate, trans-create, and localize content for social and community channels
  • Support strategic planning and operational delivery across social and community initiatives

What We’re Looking For

A successful candidate needs to have confidence and strength in the following abilities:

  • Be a proactive, self-starter and independent contributor with follow-through on all initiatives
  • Have strong problem-solving, creative writing, and editorial skills
  • Showcase strong communication skills and feel comfortable communicating both the good and the bad
  • Be confident connecting with clients and colleagues via video calls
  • Enjoy engaging with and developing a broad range of people, communities, clients, and trends
  • Be able to execute community initiatives, measure results, and modify programs based on feedback
  • Retain and demonstrate excellent organization and time-management skills, with the ability to schedule work effectively and meet deliverable deadlines
  • Be flexible and able to meet client deadlines
  • Have experience managing communities on behalf of professional entities or companies, either as a Junior Community Manager or Lead Community Manager
  • Have active and professional experience with forums, Discord, Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Instagram
  • Experience with additional platforms such as Snapchat, TikTok, Twitch, YouTube, etc. is a bonus
  • Be a creative copywriter who understands the balance between professionalism and meta, fun community initiatives
  • Have professional translation and localization experience into your native language
  • Be passionate about Anime and Manga
  • Have strong knowledge of UK culture and the UK marketing region, with personal experience living or working professionally in the supported market(s)
  • Be an anime superfan

Desired skills and pluses:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, with a minimum of 4 years in Social or Community Management experience
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to communicate with a wide variety of disciplines, articulate key points, and present information effectively
  • Strong understanding of social media and community management

About AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL)

The AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL) is an applied research initiative studying how workforce conditions influence delivery of mission-critical investments and public programs. WIL builds methodology-transparent workforce intelligence and STEM education and workforce research partnerships with universities, community colleges, and K-14 partners — packaged for grant and sponsored-research pursuits.

Learn more:

We engage experienced researchers and practitioners for both full-time employment and project-based contract roles, depending on the award and staffing model. Engagements are remote-first with travel as required for partner campuses, school districts, and field sites. We build ready teams for live grant and sponsored-research pursuits — not speculative staffing banks.

This opportunity is contingent upon grant or sponsored-project award and final staffing approval. Permission will be requested before including a candidate's name or resume in a proposal or funding package.

WIL is seeking Adjunct / Affiliated Research Faculty in STEM education and workforce domains — including engineering education, computer science education, teacher research experiences, technician education pathways, and related STEM learning and workforce research — to serve as research collaborators, co-investigators, or content leads with university and community-college partners on WIL-aligned sponsored projects.

What you'll do:
Contribute STEM education or engineering/CS education research design, methods, and scholarly framing for university-hosted sponsored projects
Collaborate with institutional PIs, school-district or community-college partners, and WIL research leads on research questions, curricula translation, and broader-impacts narratives
Support K-14 educator research-experience models, classroom/curriculum follow-on, and workforce pathway documentation when the project design calls for it
Produce high-quality written products — literature framing, methods sections, evaluation plans, progress reports, and past-performance narrative — suitable for NSF-style and related education packages
Contribute specialist qualifications and citeable past projects to WIL grant and sponsored-research packages when permissioned

Requirements

Required:

Doctorate or equivalent scholarly credentials in engineering education, STEM education, computer science education, learning sciences, or a closely related field — or substantial faculty-equivalent research experience in those domains
Demonstrated record of STEM education, teacher professional development, technician education, or engineering/CS education research (publications, funded projects, or citeable institutional roles)
Ability to collaborate with university or community-college sponsored-research teams and K-14 or industry education partners
Open to full-time employment or project-based contract engagement; remote-first with travel as partner and field work requires

Nice to have:

Prior NSF STEM education, RET Site, ATE, RIEF/RFE, IUSE, or related education-research experience as PI, co-PI, senior personnel, or key collaborator
Experience mentoring engineering faculty new to education research, or translating authentic research into K-14 classroom practice
Prior projects you can cite (agency or institution, your role, year)

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb is a vision and mission driven company. Our Product Managers (PMs) embody this culture and mindset. Platform Product Managers here imagine the ideal end state for our community (guests and hosts) first, work backwards from it, and deliver the vision in a scalable way. They champion a winning strategy and leverage metrics to ensure we are making progress against it. They partner with talented cross-functional team members (across product marketing, engineering, design, analytics, etc.) and lead teams to execute upon a shared vision. We are looking for leaders who want to join us in this journey to accomplish our mission of creating belonging everywhere.

The Difference You Will Make:

A support journey starts from the moment a guest or a host reaches out for help and ends when his/her challenge is resolved. PMs at Community Experience Platform lead cross team collaborations and deliver best-of-the-class support experience and platform capabilities. Keen eyes on great user experience, strong collaboration and influence skills are must-haves to thrive as a PM in Community Experience Platform. The Senior Platform Product Manager, Community Experience Platform will be responsible for major experience platforms that power Airbnb’s support experiences. The successful candidate will lead high profile projects and work collaboratively across multiple cross functional teams across the company

A Typical Day:

  • Understand the competitive landscape. Challenge the status quo. Influence design and product marketing team and inspire people towards a unified outcome.
  • Define success with clearly measurable objectives and key results.
  • Define a winning product strategy and create a sound roadmap.
  • Align the vision, OKR, strategy and roadmap with senior leaders and stakeholders across the company.
  • Prioritize work based on inputs from many stakeholders, while being flexible to iterate/change.
  • Maintain product backlog and the product roadmap.
  • Partner with senior tech leads and execute the vision with cross function leaders from multiple teams.
  • Present product roadmap and status to the leadership on an ongoing basis.

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of product management, or product design experience ( at least 5 out of the 8 years in a product management role).
  • Exceptional communication skills. Being able to adapt communication style for different types of audiences.
  • Ability to appreciate and articulate great user experience.
  • Ability to quickly absorb technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience.
  • Outcome-oriented. Articulates the desired outcome and works collaboratively to create a path to achieve it.
  • Experience working with partners beyond just one’s immediate cross functional team in a product management or business role.
  • Radical thinking paired with strong execution. Can envision a world different from the status quo with the ability to articulate a clear path to get there.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$179,000—$207,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ or @ email addresses. raw.description:
About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Expertise in data architecture and data operations
  • Expertise in database or data integration practices
  • Experience in AI-ready data management approaches
  • Experience with using agents in data management processes
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 172,000 USD - 202,500 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Job Description Summary

The Global Senior Director for Pharma Partnerships is responsible for building, leading, and delivering GE HealthCare’s strategic pharmaceutical alliances to advance both approved and pipeline radiopharmaceutical assets.
This role operates as the enterprise alliance manager for key pharma partnerships, owning senior executive relationships and ensuring delivery of joint strategic, clinical, and commercial objectives. The Director defines partnership strategy, shapes deal constructs, and establishes governance frameworks that enable efficient execution and value realization across the lifecycle.
Working cross-functionally, the leader ensures GE HealthCare assets—including FAPI and the Alzheimer’s disease portfolio—are embedded within pharma development programs, enabling CDx pathways, de-risking development, and ensuring successful global commercialization. The role is central to positioning GE HealthCare as the partner of choice for both pharma and providers. Success in this role is defined by embedding GE HealthCare assets into leading pharma programs, enabling CDx pathways at scale, and consistently delivering partnership value that translates into commercial leadership.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy & Asset Integration

  • Define and lead the global pharma partnership strategy, aligned to priority assets and disease areas with initial focus on FAPI and AD portfolio
  • Proactively identify and secure opportunities to embed GE HealthCare diagnostics within pharma pipelines and clinical programs
  • Drive early “design-in” of assets to maximize probability of CDx adoption and downstream commercial success
  • Translate partnership insights into portfolio priorities and stage-gate investment decisions
  • Collaborate with CMC, supply chain, regulatory affairs and R&D to build capabilities that enables GEHC to deliver on key pharma partnership priorities

Deal Structuring, Governance & Value Delivery

  • Shape partnership structures, including scope, financial frameworks, milestones, and governance mechanisms
  • Ensure alignment between contractual commitments and operational delivery across all functions
  • Define and track partnership KPIs, ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and value realization
  • Oversee execution of partnership deliverables, including co-development, supply, and commercialization components

Alliance Management & Executive Engagement

  • Serve as the primary alliance manager across strategic pharma partnerships, with end-to-end accountability for outcomes
  • Own C-suite and senior stakeholder relationships, ensuring alignment on strategy, priorities, and value creation
  • Establish and lead Joint Steering Committees and executive governance forums
  • Drive clear escalation pathways, decision rights, and operating cadence to maintain execution velocity

Cross-Functional Integration & Execution

  • Lead cross-functional orchestration across Clinical, Regulatory, Medical, Market Access, Supply, and Commercial teams
  • Align development strategies to enable CDx labeling with efficient clinical and regulatory pathways
  • Coordinate global commercial strategy and launch readiness in alignment with pharma partners
  • Act as the internal integrator to ensure consistency of strategy, messaging, and execution across teams

Risk Management

  • Identify and proactively manage risks across clinical, regulatory, operational, and commercial dimensions
  • Establish structured feedback loops from partnerships to inform future deal-making and asset strategy
  • Drive disciplined, data-based stage-gate decisions based on partnership performance and emerging evidence

External Positioning

  • Reinforce GE HealthCare’s position as a preferred pharma partner through high-quality execution and credibility
  • Build long-term relationships across pharma development, BD, and product leadership teams
  • Expand partnership opportunities across priority assets and disease areas through proactive engagement

Ideal Profile

  • Significant experience in pharmaceutical partnerships, business development, or alliance management, including structuring and executing complex collaborations across development and commercialization
  • Experience shaping partnership strategy and translating it into deal structures, operational plans, and measurable outcomes
  • Strong external credibility, with experience engaging pharma partners, business development leaders, and scientific stakeholders
  • Demonstrated track record of managing strategic partnerships end-to-end, including governance, Joint Steering Committees, and executive-level stakeholder engagement
  • Strong understanding of drug and diagnostic development, with experience supporting or enabling CDx strategies, clinical development programs, and regulatory pathways
  • Proven ability to operate in complex, cross-functional global environments and influence without direct authority across R&D, clinical, regulatory, and commercial teams
  • Experience working across global markets, with appreciation of regional differences in clinical development, regulatory, and market access pathways
  • Track record of influencing C-suite stakeholders and driving alignment across organizations in high-stakes partnerships
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $193,600.00-$290,400.00 Annual. About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions, and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. As a Senior Director within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, you will establish yourself as a credible voice in the application security space at local, regional, and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, you will produce pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

Hot Topics of Discussion with Client CIOs and Heads of IT:

  • How to create a security compliance policy for Enterprise Application vendors to adhere to?

  • How to create a risk assessment program to evaluate Enterprise Application vendors?

  • How to develop metrics to measure success?

  • How to create an application security policy that achieves an enterprise’s overall application and business strategies?

  • Identifying strengths and weaknesses of the major application vendors (i.e., SAP, Salesforce, Workday and Oracle) security tools

  • Have a good understanding of the capabilities of security tools from 3rd party vendors that are compatible with mega vendor applications which enable vulnerability identification

  • How to build and operate an application security vulnerability testing program.

  • Advise on the Key Vulnerabilities and Attack Surfaces to Test for mega vendors.

What you will need:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; graduate degree preferred

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in application security, enterprise applications, or IT leadership

  • Extensive knowledge in working with CIOs (or ‘Heads of IT’) and business leaders on developing application security strategies with delivering business value (i.e., performance metrics, decision authority between the business and application teams, relationship management with the business, etc.)

  • Strong familiarity with creating Enterprise Application Security Roadmaps and Performance Metrics preferred

  • An ability to articulate the role application security technology plays in delivering business value

  • Experience in organizing and leading application security teams (i.e., location of work, roles & responsibilities, operating model, organization design, evaluating application team performance, budget / finance, relationships with Enterprise Architect and PMO teams, etc.)

  • Remain ahead of the curve on developments and issues within these specified areas as well as applicable adjacent areas of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Job Purpose

The purpose of the Scoping & Licensing Specialist role is to support the accurate scoping, quoting and licensing of client projects, ensuring requirements are clearly understood and projects are set up for successful delivery. The role works closely with clients and internal teams to provide accurate information, support efficient project planning and contribute to a high-quality client experience.

About Transform

At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting-edge language technology, AI-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Communicate with clients to gather project requirements and ensure accurate and timely quotations.
  • Review clinical trial protocols and client request forms to identify relevant information relating to instrument usage and project requirements.
  • Prepare licensing quotation modules and support clients with changes to project scope, requirements and priorities.
  • Maintain clear and accurate records of scope changes and project updates.
  • Research previous translation projects and questionnaires to identify existing work, avoid duplication and determine applicable archive discounts.
  • Prepare basic and intermediate Linguistic Validation (LV) quotations, including word counts, formatting requirements and estimated resource needs.
  • Process basic and intermediate Linguistic Validation projects according to client requirements and established procedures.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure estimates are accurate, achievable and aligned with available resources.
  • Assign standard and urgent projects to appropriate qualified translators and debriefers based on language, expertise, availability and deadlines.
  • Ensure translators and other resources receive clear and accurate project instructions.
  • Coordinate with Finance to support accurate invoicing and payment processing.
  • Support and improve licensing and repository processes based on client feedback.
  • Identify and escalate resource, quality or delivery issues when required.
  • Contribute to process improvements and maintain consistency and quality across deliverables.
  • Support the onboarding and mentoring of junior team members when required.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree with approximately 1–2 years of relevant professional experience preferred.
  • Previous experience in COA licensing and/or Linguistic Validation is highly desirable.
  • Experience with medical terminology, clinical research or related healthcare environments is desirable.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to find, interpret, summarise and compile information from different sources.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong planning, organisation and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple requests and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working in a structured, deadline-driven environment and managing competing priorities.
  • Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to understand project requirements and select appropriate resources based on language, expertise, availability and quality requirements.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other business systems, with the ability to learn new tools.
  • Understanding of quality requirements and the ability to work within established QMS processes and standards, including ISO 9001 and ISO 17100.
  • Ability to handle confidential information appropriately and maintain accurate documentation.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

About Backstory

Backstory (formerly People.ai) is the leading AI answers platform for sales teams. With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like Red Hat, Five9, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue.

By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue.

Recognized by Gartner and Forrester, the Inc. 5000, Y Combinator Top Companies, and the Forbes AI 50, Backstory is based in San Francisco and backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures and Mubadala Capital.

The Role

As Senior Manager of Demand Generation at Backstory, you will own how buyers find us and how they convert into pipeline. This is an AI-first marketing seat—equal parts strategy and hands-on execution. You will manage paid media, agency partners, web conversion, and organic discovery across both traditional search engines and AI answer engines. Partnering directly with the SVP of Marketing, you will commit to an enterprise pipeline target and build the automated systems to hit it.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in Demand Generation / Growth Marketing at a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise AI startup.

  • AI-Forward Operator: Proven track record of testing and integrating cutting-edge AI software into campaign operations. You are deeply technical with modern tools (Clay, Make/n8n, LLM prompts, AI creative suites) and constantly look for ways to replace manual marketing tasks with automated AI workflows.

  • Proven Pipeline Ownership: Track record of owning a qualified enterprise pipeline number and managing paid digital budgets end-to-end.

Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, Backstory is backed by Y Combinator and Silicon Valley’s top investors, including ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures, and Mubadala Capital. raw.excerpt: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
raw.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

This is a hands-on, business-owner product leadership role, not a pure strategy or coordination seat. An experienced product manager reports to you, with full people responsibility, and dedicated cloud engineering teams partner with you daily. You operate like a general manager, fluent in packaging, pricing models, and metering, and conversant in NDR and GDR. You understand the whole business, from sales enablement and marketing through inbound and digital motion to field events and channel partners, and hold every investment to a strong ROI. You also carry the platform responsibility everything else depends on: performance, availability, migration, and cost. You bring an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI in the day-to-day work of the team to maximize efficiency and output.

Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.

We are seeking an exceptional product leader to own the vision, strategy, and execution of MetaDefender Cloud, the verdict as an API. Enterprises, governments, and technology partners send it files and get back a decision they can trust (“is this file safe to admit?”) at any volume. This is business ownership of a trust-critical enterprise cloud: the commercial ladder from self-serve developer entry to a top tier for regulated buyers, and everything that makes it credible, from contractual SLAs, availability, and failover to compliance, cost efficiency, and a platform other OPSWAT services build on. You will grow the business through product-led motion, cloud marketplaces, distribution channels, and a Technology Partners program that makes joining our ecosystem a product action, not a sales project.

MetaDefender Cloud delivers OPSWAT’s prevention technologies (multiscanning, Deep CDR, and AI-driven analysis) as a cloud service, and is the shared platform behind a growing family of OPSWAT cloud offerings. This role owns that business end to end:

  • The Prevention Ladder:one coherent tier ladder from self-serve developer entry to full enterprise, sold to one buyer who moves up as throughput and analysis depth grow.
  • The Regulated Enterprise:the top of the ladder: dedicated capacity, the strictest SLAs, large-file support, and a strict data-privacy and data-handling posture for regulated industries.
  • A Resilient, Compliant Cloud:reliability as a product, with availability targets, failover, recovery objectives, multi-region resilience, and certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2 that make trust a reason to buy.
  • The Platform Behind OPSWAT’s Cloud Services:one API and platform that web proxy and ICAP protection, MetaDefender Secure Storage, email security, MetaDefender for Salesforce, and the threat-hunting tier build on.
  • Performance & Cost Efficiency:industry-leading speed to verdict, and a cost-per-scan discipline that protects margin as volume grows. You own the unit economics.
  • Technology Partners & Developer Ecosystem:the program for engine partners who strengthen detection, integration partners who put our verdict where security teams work, and developers who build it into their own products.
  • Marketplaces & Distribution:taking the product where buyers already purchase: cloud marketplaces such as AWS and Azure, distribution channels, and reseller partners, plus new offerings, such as MetaDefender Private for dedicated deployments, as the market demands.

What You Will be Doing

  • Own the business:define and champion the vision, strategy, and roadmap for MetaDefender Cloud, and be accountable for growth, adoption, and commercial outcomes.
  • Own reliability as a product:make contractual SLAs (latency, availability, and recovery objectives) the standard across every tier, and drive high availability, automatic failover, and multi-region resilience from roadmap to contract.
  • Own compliance & regulation:maintain and extend our certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, and beyond) and the data-privacy and data-residency posture, so regulated buyers can say yes.
  • Run the platform for its stakeholders:treat the OPSWAT services built on the cloud (web proxy and ICAP, secure storage, email, Salesforce, threat hunting) as first-class customers, balancing their needs with one coherent platform.
  • Own pricing & packaging:design and maintain the prevention tier ladder, packaging, metering, and discount guidance, steward the one price book with your Aether counterpart, and monitor realization against list.
  • Drive cost efficiency:own cost per scan and the margin story, and make efficiency a continuous, measured program.
  • Lead the platform evolution:carry customers through major platform transitions, with migration paths that never ask them to break their integration, and retire legacy offerings cleanly.
  • Grow marketplaces & distribution:list the product on the cloud marketplaces where buyers already purchase, grow channel and reseller partnerships, and build the no-touch motion behind them.
  • Build the Technology Partners program:make joining the ecosystem a product action, with SDKs, API documentation, and automated onboarding and vetting, so every engine, integration, and developer partner adds detection, reach, or data.
  • Champion product-led growth:the product sells the product. Own every self-serve and paid-conversion motion, including from the free community, plus the inbound and digital funnels and the upgrade path.
  • Tailor the experience to the persona:know the cloud architect, platform engineer, and enterprise security leader in financial services, SaaS, and technology, and shape onboarding, console, and API experiences around their daily work.
  • Enable the field & measure ROI:own sales enablement and the proof the field needs, show up at the anchor events that matter, work channel partners deliberately, and hold every motion to a strong ROI.
  • Monitor the business:track the KPIs that matter (tier mix, NDR and GDR, realization, platform performance, unit cost) and use them to steer investment.
  • Build and lead the team:lead, mentor, and grow the MetaDefender Cloud product team, small and senior today, and scale it as the business scales.
  • Communicate with stakeholders:clearly articulate strategy, progress, and results to internal teams, executive leadership, and customers, fostering alignment and enthusiasm.

What We Need from You

  • Product management experience:5+ years in product management of cloud or SaaS products, ideally in cybersecurity or another trust-critical enterprise service. Experience leading product managers is a strong plus.

  • Marketplace & channel experience:you have grown a product through cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), channel, or reseller partners, or built that motion from zero.
  • Platform product thinking:experience evolving a shared platform that multiple products build on, balancing reuse with each consumer’s speed and autonomy.
  • Product-led growth:experience with self-serve, developer-facing offerings: onboarding funnels, API-first products, and conversion into enterprise contracts.
  • Persona-driven product craft:a track record of building experiences around sharply defined users, backed by research, usage data, and design partnership.
  • AI-first ways of working:an AI-first mindset: you actively apply AI tools to your own and your team’s daily work to move faster and raise quality.
  • Hands-on and technical:comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with R&D day to day, engaging credibly on APIs, cloud architecture, and trade-offs, and going deep in the product.

  • Exceptional communicator:outstanding interpersonal and executive communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams and credibility with customers and leadership.
  • Travel:willingness to travel regularly to field events, customers, and R&D sites.
  • Education:Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • Ways of working:familiarity with Agile methodologies or similar frameworks.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own the prevent half of a focused two-product strategy at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader: a trust-critical cloud with executive attention.

About AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL)

The AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL) is an applied research initiative studying how workforce conditions influence delivery of mission-critical investments and public programs. WIL builds methodology-transparent workforce intelligence and STEM education and workforce research partnerships with universities, community colleges, and K-14 partners — packaged for grant and sponsored-research pursuits.

Learn more:

We engage experienced researchers and practitioners for both full-time employment and project-based contract roles, depending on the award and staffing model. Engagements are remote-first with travel as required for partner campuses, school districts, and field sites. We build ready teams for live grant and sponsored-research pursuits — not speculative staffing banks.

This opportunity is contingent upon grant or sponsored-project award and final staffing approval. Permission will be requested before including a candidate's name or resume in a proposal or funding package.

WIL is seeking Adjunct / Affiliated Research Faculty in STEM education and workforce domains — including engineering education, computer science education, teacher research experiences, technician education pathways, and related STEM learning and workforce research — to serve as research collaborators, co-investigators, or content leads with university and community-college partners on WIL-aligned sponsored projects.

What you'll do:
Contribute STEM education or engineering/CS education research design, methods, and scholarly framing for university-hosted sponsored projects
Collaborate with institutional PIs, school-district or community-college partners, and WIL research leads on research questions, curricula translation, and broader-impacts narratives
Support K-14 educator research-experience models, classroom/curriculum follow-on, and workforce pathway documentation when the project design calls for it
Produce high-quality written products — literature framing, methods sections, evaluation plans, progress reports, and past-performance narrative — suitable for NSF-style and related education packages
Contribute specialist qualifications and citeable past projects to WIL grant and sponsored-research packages when permissioned

Requirements

Required:

Doctorate or equivalent scholarly credentials in engineering education, STEM education, computer science education, learning sciences, or a closely related field — or substantial faculty-equivalent research experience in those domains
Demonstrated record of STEM education, teacher professional development, technician education, or engineering/CS education research (publications, funded projects, or citeable institutional roles)
Ability to collaborate with university or community-college sponsored-research teams and K-14 or industry education partners
Open to full-time employment or project-based contract engagement; remote-first with travel as partner and field work requires

Nice to have:

Prior NSF STEM education, RET Site, ATE, RIEF/RFE, IUSE, or related education-research experience as PI, co-PI, senior personnel, or key collaborator
Experience mentoring engineering faculty new to education research, or translating authentic research into K-14 classroom practice
Prior projects you can cite (agency or institution, your role, year)

raw.description:
Why Ethicrithm?

Ethicrithm is a Palantir partner serving clients across North America. We specialize in integrating and structuring enterprise data, developing AI-driven solutions, and implementing intelligent operating systems with Palantir Foundry and AIP. We deliver secure, scalable, and impactful solutions that optimize business operations and drive measurable returns on investment, impact and results. We’re building a high-performance team of humble, helpful, and client-oriented teammates.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you own the successful delivery and real-world impact of Palantir Foundry for our clients. Your role is to deeply understand clients’ most critical operational problems and translate those needs into workflows and capabilities that drive meaningful outcomes.

You work closely with client teams across the organization—from frontline operators to executive leaders—to understand how decisions are made, what the data reveals, and how Foundry can be applied to improve those decisions in practice. You guide deployments from early problem framing through execution, ensuring solutions are adopted, trusted, and impactful.

You excel in ambiguous, fastmoving environments, creating clarity by forming hypotheses, testing assumptions, and iterating quickly to move clients toward their highest value outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Scoping:Engage with stakeholders through workshops and interviews across the client’s business to deeply understand their business processes, friction points, strategic goals, and data landscape.
  • Solution Design:Develop capabilities that deliver impact in the client’s business by determining how Foundry can be implemented against business problems.
  • Deployment Governance:Oversee the governance framework for deployments, ensuring shared understanding of objectives, scope, timelines, and execution approach. Track progress, surface risks, and communicate value delivered throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Driving User Adoption:Drive user adoption through training, friction removal, and sustained partnership with end users.
  • Stakeholder Management:Build relationships with executives, operators, and technical leads; align teams on shared goals; and navigate competing priorities to keep delivery focused on outcomes.
  • Value Realization:Define and measure the impact of deployments and demonstrate the value delivered to clients.
  • Services Feedback:Surface insights from the field to provide tangible recommendations on Ethicrithm’s practices.
  • Field Engagement:Go onsite to meet with client operators, understand the critical questions they need to answer, and locate their highest-impact problems firsthand.
  • Data Identification:Identify the relevant datasets that matter most by deeply engaging with client workflows and understanding how data connects to the decisions clients are trying to improve.
  • Growth and Expansion:Scope out potential engagements in new industries and expanding geographies, helping to shape where Ethicrithm goes next.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Technical Aptitude: A strong understanding of software and data concepts. You can write code that works, architect solutions, and solve technical problems alongside Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs).
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically about client challenges and develop innovative solutions
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of business principles and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Project Management: Proven project management skills, including experience developing and executing project plans
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify and address potential roadblocks
  • Client-Facing Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with clients. Empathy and a desire to understand client needs
  • Ability to travel in Canada and the US (approx 5% travel) without the need for Visas or other documents requiring processing time

Preferred with flexibility for exceptional candidates

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
  • Experience designing and delivering technical solutions
  • Deep experience working with data (analysis, modeling, data engineering)
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry / AIP
  • Experience with Python and/or TypeScript

Research shows candidates from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed criteria. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we'd still like to hear from you!

Total Rewards

We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your well-being and career growth. This includes a competitive salary, equity participation (subject to plan terms and eligibility), 401(k) with company matching, and medical, dental, and vision coverage. You'll enjoy four weeks of paid vacation, sick leave in accordance with applicable state and local law, and the flexibility of working from home. As a growing AI implementation company at the forefront of enterprise technology, we offer meaningful opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

Summary

Fire Creek Services Company, an All Native Group company, is seeking a System Engineer to stand up and run the cloud hosting environment for a maintenance management platform, including configuration, deployment automation, monitoring, backup and recovery, mobile device (tablet) management and platform integration support. This is an immediate opening.

Essential Functions

  • Configure the approved hosting environment, network boundary and connection path, and maintain hardening baselines.
  • Automate deployments and environment builds; maintain software, dependency and vulnerability inventories.
  • Run monitoring, alerting, patch testing and incident response with the Cybersecurity / RMF Lead.
  • Implement and test backup and restoration, demonstrating successful restores.
  • Manage technician tablets through Microsoft Intune (enrollment, remote lock and wipe, role-based downloads and spare pool).
  • Support sensor gateway and building automation network segmentation with the Low-Voltage / IoT Technician.
  • Enforce least-privilege administrative access and review privileged accounts regularly.
  • Follow change management processes for infrastructure changes, including approval, testing and rollback plans.
  • Support ITIL-aligned incident and problem management, including root-cause analysis and runbook updates.

Competencies

  • Cloud systems engineering (Azure)
  • Automation and scripting
  • Security hardening and compliance
  • Incident response and troubleshooting

None required for this position

Work Environment

Remote or office-based, computer-focused work, with periodic on-site travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lb.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

Full-time and part-time positions available. Typical hours are Monday through Friday, daytime. This position participates in an on-call rotation for platform outages, shared with vendor support.

Travel

Periodic travel to Fort Campbell, Kentucky, for system installation and support.

Experience

  • 6+ years of systems or cloud engineering experience.
  • 2+ years operating workloads in Azure Government or another DoD IL4/IL5 environment.
  • Operated a production environment subject to RMF/ATO controls.
  • Scripting and automation (PowerShell, Python, Bicep or Terraform).

Preferred:

  • Infrastructure as code.
  • Intune/MDM for rugged tablets.
  • Backup and disaster recovery testing.
  • Monitoring and log management.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs or CIS benchmarks.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • CompTIA Security+ (DoD 8140 IAT Level II) required for privileged access.
  • Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect certification preferred.

None

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. However, preference may be extended to persons of Indian descent in accordance with applicable laws.

About Ho-Chunk, Inc. & All Native Group

Ho-Chunk, Inc. is an award-winning economic development corporation of the Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska. Our mission is to provide long-term economic development for the Winnebago Tribe and job opportunities for Tribal members.

All Native Group is a network of small businesses that support the critical missions of various U.S. Government customers. Our capabilities include telecommunications, health, logistics, specialized training, professional services, and IT solutions. Since earning our first federal contract in 2004, we have continued to grow and diversify our services while maintaining a strong commitment to excellence. As a tribally owned organization, All Native Group operates multiple subsidiary businesses, providing clients with the advantages of working with a small business while leveraging the resources and expertise of a larger, established company.
