Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Engagement Manager at Chooose, you will partner with our enterprise customers in the aviation and energy sectors, enabling them to build and operate their SAF programs. In close collaboration with the Chooose Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest customers in your assigned region, supporting customers across their entire experience with the Chooose platform, from implementation to solution go-live and beyond.
This is a remote role that must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida
Alt ID: Strategic Account Manager / Client Partner / Engagement Manager / Enterprise CSM / Strategic Account Lead

What you'll do

  • Own total responsibility for a portfolio of key enterprise customers within the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors.
  • Become the expert on the customer's SAF program. Thoroughly understand the customer’s program objectives, and guide how the customer leverages the Chooose platform to reach these objectives.
  • Cultivate high-trust relationships with key stakeholders across our customer organizations (from Sustainability to Fuel Procurement) and function as the customer's trusted advisor.
  • Drive customer success. Assess, clarify, and validate customer needs and new commercial expansion opportunities on an ongoing basis. Proactively qualify and champion these needs and opportunities internally, with an emphasis on gathering and delivering structured product feedback.
  • Maintain a balanced approach and multiple perspectives. Enable commercial growth while considering Chooose's commitment to enabling long-term, high-integrity climate action.
  • Manage complex software deployments. Supported by an assigned Technical Implementation Manager and other key resources, oversee the implementation of complex decarbonization programs including a range of climate solutions from Sustainable Aviation Fuel to carbon offsets and removals.
  • Refine our playbook. Drive continuous improvement across Technical Implementation, Customer Operations, and Customer Success functions.
  • Collaborate with multiple Chooose teams to execute the operational tasks needed to achieve program objectives on time and with high quality.
  • Proactively and continually educate yourself on the carbon-related requirements and market trends impacting our customers and the sectors in which we operate.

What you bring to the table

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.
  • Minimum of 4 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise project management, or similar.
  • Experience in enterprise software organizations relating to carbon markets, fuel markets, or carbon accounting is a plus.
  • Technical capability. You enjoy helping customers solve business and technical problems, and are comfortable with technical and highly configurable SaaS solutions. Previous experience with API integrations and enterprise-grade SaaS solutions is a plus.
  • You listen carefully and authentically care about solving customer problems.
  • Polished presentation skills and are comfortable discussing technical and commercial topics with external stakeholders.
  • Self-directed problem solver who takes initiative
  • Flexible with work hours for global customer support.
  • You're willing to be flexible with your work hours to support your colleagues and accommodate our global customers.
  • You’re open to frequent travel on short notice.
  • You have superior verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Spanish is a plus.
  • Must be based in Illinois, Texas, Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will involve a practical exercise for you to show your work. You’ll receive written instructions for the exercise in advance, and we’ll then schedule a time to discuss. The third and final phase consists of a one-on-one conversation with a member of our executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

We offer fantastic benefits that include up to a 10% match on 401K on your hire start, with a vesting timeline of only one year, along with medical benefits that start on day onewith a 30% premium rebate annually! We value your well-being and all employees now have access to the Calm app for FREE, which is used for meditation, stress management, and better sleep. Through our performance management program, you can earn additional annual incentives as you set and achieve goals. Our pay for performance culture motivates our employees to improve Delek’s year-over-year company, business unit, and individual results. With some of the highest bonus payouts in recent years, we know that our success is due to our talented and dedicated team. We are looking for individuals like you to help us continue this momentum and bring new ideas to the table. At Delek, you will have the opportunity to make an impact and grow your career in a supportive and innovative environment.

Job Summary:

Delek US Holdings, Inc. is a diversified downstream energy company with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt, renewable fuels and convenience store retailing. We are hiring for the position of Alkylation Technology SME with the potential for site or remote work.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the corporate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for HF and sulfuric acid alkylation technology, providing technical leadership and support across all refining assets.
  • Develop, maintain, and monitor unit performance indicators, benchmarking metrics, and technology health dashboards to identify performance gaps, reliability risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Serve as the corporate steward and technical authority for HF and sulfuric acid alkylation process safety standards, engineering best practices, and risk management strategies.
  • Own and maintain corporate alkylation technology standards, operating envelopes, critical process parameter guidance, and lessons-learned documentation to ensure consistent execution across all refining assets.
  • Provide technical consultation and troubleshooting support to refinery process engineers, production teams, and operations personnel on unit performance, process optimization, operating issues, and process safety concerns.
  • Lead efforts to improve alkylation unit safety, reliability, environmental performance, and economic optimization through application of industry best practices and sound engineering principles.
  • Develop, maintain, monitor, and benchmark key alkylation performance indicators, including process safety, reliability, acid consumption, alkylate quality, equipment performance, and unit energy intensity.
  • Mentor and develop refinery process engineers, technical supervisors, and operations leaders through coaching, technical training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain corporate standards, best practices, engineering guidelines, and operating philosophies related to alkylation technology.
  • Lead the refinery alkylation best-practice network and facilitate periodic technology collaboration meetings, including agenda development, action tracking, knowledge sharing, and deployment of lessons learned.
  • Coordinate and lead annual technology health assessments for alkylation units, including performance reviews, gap identification, risk assessment, and improvement plan development.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, licensor developments, catalyst advancements, process improvements, and industry trends to identify opportunities for business improvement and competitive advantage.
  • Maintain active engagement with technology licensors, catalyst suppliers, engineering consultants, industry organizations, and peer networks to ensure awareness and application of current industry best practices and technological advancements.
  • Support process studies and technology evaluations focused on yield improvement, energy efficiency, asset utilization, environmental compliance, process safety, and profitability enhancement.
  • Provide technical leadership during unit startups, shutdowns, major operating events, turnarounds, commissioning activities, and post-startup performance stabilization efforts.
  • Participate in and provide technical leadership for process hazard analyses (PHA), layer of protection analyses (LOPA), management of change (MOC) reviews, pre-startup safety reviews (PSSR), and other process safety management activities impacting alkylation units.
  • Serve as the technical authority for alkylation-related management of change reviews, significant process deviations, operating envelope exceedances, and major technology recommendations.
  • Lead or participate in incident investigations and root cause failure analyses involving process safety events, reliability incidents, environmental events, and production losses. Partner with reliability, maintenance, and operations personnel to identify corrective actions, capture lessons learned, and prevent recurrence.
  • Own and facilitate the development, maintenance, and deployment of alkylation-specific training materials, operating guidance, and competency development programs.
  • Support capital project development through concept evaluation, technology selection, design review, risk assessment, process design package review, and startup readiness activities.
  • Provide periodic updates and recommendations to refinery and corporate leadership regarding technology risks, constraints, performance gaps, improvement opportunities, and long-range strategic initiatives.
  • Exercise broad technical judgment and independent decision-making to resolve complex technical issues and influence business outcomes across multiple facilities.
  • Support other refining process technologies and business initiatives as required based on organizational needs, individual expertise, and business priorities.
  • This position relies on extensive industry experience, advanced technical knowledge, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to influence organizational decisions across multiple refining assets. A high degree of creativity, initiative, leadership, and independent decision-making is expected.

Required Qualifications – Education, Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering.
  • 15+ years refining experience.
  • 10+ years supporting alkylation technology.
  • Expertise in operation, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance improvement of HF and sulfuric acid alkylation units.
  • Knowledge of alkylation reaction chemistry and process fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with HYSYS and applicable process modeling software.
  • Experience with startups, shutdowns, and turnarounds.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
  • Knowledge of process safety management principles and regulatory requirements.
  • Familiarity with staged-gate project development processes.

Preferred Qualifications – Education, Skills & Experience:

  • Experience with both HF and sulfuric acid alkylation technologies.
  • Experience leading or participating in PHAs, LOPAs, MOCs, and PSSRs.
  • Experience developing corporate standards and best practices.
  • Experience serving as a corporate or multi-site technology resource.
  • Experience with technology-specific modeling software.
  • Participation in industry committees, licensor forums, or professional organizations.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

Core Competencies:

CHANGE AGILITY (LEVEL 3 APPLYING): Identifies, initiates, and adapts to organizational changes that foster enhanced effectiveness, efficiency, safety, and ultimately business results.

COLLABORATION (LEVEL 3 APPLYING): Sees connection points across the organization and partners effectively with others to achieve common goals.

DECISION MAKING (LEVEL 3 APPLYING): Selects a course of action to reduce risk and uncertainty and create optimal outcomes.

DRIVE FOR RESULTS (LEVEL 3 APPLYING): Drives to achieve challenging performance objectives.

TEAM BUILDING (LEVEL 3 APPLYING): Builds trust, fosters openness, and provides support. As the manager of a team, selects and motivates a strong team.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. raw.description:
Connectivity Director I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor is looking for a Connectivity Director to own the technical and commercial relationship between our platform and the reservation systems (restechs) our supplier partners rely on. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the connectivity strategy, build C-suite relationships with restech partners, and roll up your sleeves alongside engineers when a hard integration problem needs solving.

You'll lead the team responsible for supplier and restech connectivity – the APIs, integration technologies, and configuration processes that let millions of travellers book experiences seamlessly. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and commercial teams to make sure our connectivity capability scales with the business.

Job Location: UK, offices in London and Oxford.

This role is a remote position in the United Kingdom. Occasional travel to company offices as necessary.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Connectivity strategy – a clear point of view on where supplier and restech integrations need to go, aligned to our broader technical direction (faster releases, better observability, simplification, AI driven efficiencies).

  • Build and maintain C-suite level relationships with restech and supplier partners, acting as the senior technical face of Tripadvisor in those conversations.

  • Stay genuinely hands-on: dig into API design, integration architecture, and connectivity issues directly, not just from a distance.

  • Lead, grow and mentor a team of tech leads and engineers – with experience building teams from scratch or reinvigorating existing ones globally.

  • Partner closely with Product to shape the connectivity roadmap; this is a product-oriented team and role.

  • Instigate change: bring new technologies and approaches to the team, and create space for technical creativity.

  • Own escalation and resolution of complex operational and connectivity issues, keeping transactions and integrations running smoothly at scale.

  • Oversee configuration, monitoring and testing of supplier integrations, and drive continuous improvement of the tools and processes behind them.

  • Respond quickly and positively as remit, priorities or team structure evolve.

About You

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs and restech integration technologies, and a genuine understanding of how connectivity platforms work end to end.

  • A proven track record of building senior (C-suite level) relationships with restech and supplier partners.

  • Experience building a technical or connectivity strategy and also getting hands-on to deliver against it.

  • Genuine hands-on technical experience

  • Comfortable working alongside Product as a true partner, ideally having done so before on a customer-facing site or app.

  • An inclusive, non-hierarchical leadership style

  • Energised by fast-moving environments and comfortable adapting quickly to changes in remit, priorities or structure.

  • Excellent communication and management skills, with the technical credibility to match.

  • Data/analytical mindset, ability to design and build relevant reports

Practicalities

  • This role is remote in the UK, ideally someone based in or around London

  • You'll want to build real relationships with the team, which means coming into the office from time to time.

  • Reports to the Senior Director, Destination Management.

Personal Qualities

  • Strategic Vision:A visionary thinker capable of translating complex technical challenges into clear, long-term strategic roadmaps.

  • Executive Presence:Exceptional ability to communicate and influence at the C-suite and executive levels, both internally and with external partners.

  • Adaptive Leadership:A resilient and inclusive leader, comfortable navigating and driving change in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Collaborative Catalyst:A natural partner who excels at breaking down silos and fostering cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams.

Skills and Experience Guide

  • Leadership Experience:10+ years of experience in technical leadership, connectivity strategy, or product engineering, ideally within the travel technology or B2B SaaS space.

  • Relationship Management:Proven track record of building and managing high-stakes C-suite partnerships, including technical advocacy and commercial negotiation.

  • Technical Strategy:Demonstrated experience defining and delivering technical roadmaps, API strategies, and scaling connectivity platforms in high-traffic environments.

  • Integration Expertise:Deep knowledge of integration architecture, API design, and observability, with the credibility to engage hands-on with engineering teams.

  • Team Development:Proven ability to build, mentor, and lead high-performing global engineering and technical teams from the ground up or through significant transformation.

  • Strategic Execution:Analytical mindset with the ability to design and leverage data to drive technical decision-making and operational improvements.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at .

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at . We have all the answers!

raw.description:
At Headlands Research, we are dedicated to enhancing clinical trial delivery within our communities. As a leading network of advanced clinical trial sites, we leverage cutting-edge technology and exceptional support services to broaden outreach and participation. Founded in 2018, our rapidly growing company currently operates 20+ sites across the US and Canada, with plans for further expansion.

Position Summary

The Participant Marketing Coordinator is responsible for the operational management of participant recruitment activities for assigned clinical trials across the Headlands Research network. This role serves as the primary coordinator for study marketing start-up, sponsor-funded recruitment budgets, regulatory and sponsor submissions, vendor management, and production of participant-facing marketing materials.

Working cross-functionally with Site Operations, Regulatory, Finance, Business Development, Sponsors/CROs, and external vendors, the Participant Marketing Coordinator ensures recruitment campaigns are launched on time, remain within budget, comply with regulatory requirements, and support enrollment goals.

This position combines project management, marketing operations, financial coordination, and operations relationship management to drive successful study activation and participant recruitment.

Study Start-Up & Marketing Project Management

  • Coordinate participant recruitment start-up activities for newly awarded clinical trials.
  • Develop and manage recruitment project timelines from study award through campaign launch.
  • Ensure all marketing deliverables are completed prior to study activation.
  • Track study readiness milestones and proactively identify project risks or delays.
  • Coordinate activities between Central Recruitment, Site Operations, Regulatory, Sponsors/CROs, Finance, and Business Development.
  • Maintain study launch documentation and project status reports.
  • Prioritize multiple concurrent study launches while meeting timelines.
  • Facilitate study start-up meetings and communicate updates.

Sponsor Budget Management & Financial Coordination

  • Review sponsor-approved participant recruitment budgets and contractual marketing allocations.
  • Develop study-specific recruitment budgets.
  • Manage sponsor-funded marketing budgets throughout each study.
  • Track expenditures, forecast spending, and optimize marketing investments.
  • Coordinate purchase requests, POs, invoices, and vendor payments.
  • Partner with Finance on reconciliation and reporting.
  • Prepare budget summaries for leadership and sponsors.
  • Monitor enrollment performance and prepare business justifications for supplemental funding.
  • Submit and track additional sponsor funding requests and budget amendments.

Sponsor & CRO Coordination

  • Serve as the primary operational contact regarding participant recruitment activities.
  • Coordinate sponsor review and approval of recruitment strategies and materials.
  • Prepare sponsor-facing recruitment updates and budget reports.
  • Maintain documentation of sponsor approvals and communications.

Regulatory & Submission Management

  • Prepare recruitment material packages for IRB/EC and sponsor submissions.
  • Coordinate review and approval of participant-facing materials.
  • Track approvals, amendments, and expiration dates.
  • Maintain regulatory documentation and version control.

Vendor Management

  • Manage creative agencies, print vendors, digital advertising agencies, translation services, promotional product vendors, and community outreach vendors.
  • Coordinate timelines, quotes, purchasing, invoices, and distribution of recruitment materials.

Traditional Marketing Materials

  • Coordinate creation, production, approval, and distribution of flyers, brochures, posters, rack cards, referral cards, physician referral materials, community outreach materials, event signage, direct mail, recruitment giveaways, and promotional materials.
  • Ensure all materials are IRB approved, sponsor approved, brand compliant, and delivered on schedule.

Reporting & Performance Tracking

  • Maintain reports for study start-up timelines, campaign status, budget utilization, sponsor funding requests, vendor performance, approvals, marketing ROI, and operational metrics.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership regarding project status, risks, and recruitment readiness.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Communications, Clinical Research, or related field preferred.
  • 2–5 years of project coordination, marketing operations, clinical research, or healthcare administration experience.
  • Experience with study start-up, sponsor budgets, and vendor management preferred.
Remote Pay Range
$68,000—$78,000 USD

Headlands Research will never ask a candidate for personal identifiable information (date of birth, social security number, driver’s license information, etc) via email or messenger tools, or for a financial deposit of any kind.

Headlands Research is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Need Assistance?

Headlands Research is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its employment for individuals with disabilities. To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

growing financial planning, investment management, wealth management, and retirement
planning business.

particularly around YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram. The successful candidate will help
turn long-form video content into engaging short-form content, prepare posts, optimize content
using AI tools, and make the overall publishing process more efficient.

and content. Your role will be to take the content from there and manage the editing,
repurposing, optimization, and publishing process.

● Support the management of the company's YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram presence.
● Take long-form YouTube videos and turn them into engaging short-form videos/reels for social media.

    The ideal candidate will have previous experience working with social media content, video

    ● Highly proficient in written and spoken English, with excellent communication skills.

    ● Comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools to improve content creation and efficiency.
    ● Familiar with social media posting, scheduling, captions, and content optimization.

    ● Organized and able to manage a repeatable content workflow.

Ideal Experience

    We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously helped another business

    Experience with additional social media management or content scheduling platforms would

raw.description:
EDGE is seeking qualified individuals to join our team of species experts who specialize in addressing potential impacts to protected species including freshwater mussels, fish, crayfish, mammals (bats), birds, reptiles, amphibians, rare plants, and insects for our clients in the Energy, Transportation, Chemical, and Manufacturing industries.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing, dynamic environmental consulting firm. The position would be based in one of our offices or remote for the right candidate. As a Biologist/Ecologist your primary focus will be on addressing Endangered Species Act (ESA) issues for clients, including all phases of the design and implementation of protected species surveys consistent with federal and state requirements, including project management, client management, proposal preparation, budgetary management, agency consultation, data collection, data management, and report preparation in support of projects throughout the eastern United States. There will also be opportunities for career growth through informal coaching and formal professional development, which could include attendance at conferences sponsored by industry, federal and state agencies, and scientific groups.

Today’s businesses are facing the most comprehensive and complicated suite of environmental regulations on record. At EDGE, we provide our clients the insight and expertise to achieve their business objectives amidst this complex landscape. We stand apart from other consulting firms by putting the client’s needs at the forefront of everything we do, delivering innovative and responsive solutions across multiple practice areas.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage projects and field programs.
  • Prepare technical proposals and budgetary estimates
  • Design and execute field programs to meet client safety requirements and agency protocols
  • Assist in facilitating meetings/consultation with Federal and State agencies
  • Prepare technically detailed environmental reports and documentation
  • Engage clients through participation in presentations

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.A. or B.S. in Biological Science, Environmental Science, Fisheries, Natural Resource, or related degree
  • 5 to 10 years of consulting experience
  • Knowledge of Endangered Species Act
  • Significant experience with federally- and/or state-listed protected species
  • Positive attitude, willingness to learn, ability to work within a diverse team
  • Excellent oral and written communication
  • Ability to multi-task
  • Ability to travel during survey season

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Biological Science, Environmental Science, Fisheries, Natural Resources, or related degree
  • Federal or State Scientific Collection Permit
  • SCUBA certification (aquatic professionals)
  • Boat operator certification (aquatic professionals)
  • Telemetry experience (terrestrial professionals)
  • Qualified Surveyor List (aquatic & terrestrial professionals)

EDGE strives to hire and retain the best and brightest candidates in the marketplace. To be selected for this position, the candidate must possess exceptional interpersonal skills and outstanding oral and written communication skills allowing positive internal, client and contractor relationships. Excellent technical writing skills for permit applications and reports are required, as are outstanding problem-solving abilities. The selected candidate will demonstrate passion for the business of environmental consulting, technical excellence and quality, leadership potential, a commitment to lifelong learning and growth, and the desire to build a long and rewarding career with EDGE.

Why EDGE?

  • Work That Matters. We help businesses around the world meet the environmental challenges they face. Our work not only helps the companies we serve, it ensures the products of our clients’ businesses continue to drive the economy and positively impacts the future of our planet.
  • National Reach. Local Management. We have the people and the resources to serve clients across the United States, but our small company feel is what makes us unique. Every individual within our company has the opportunity to give input on projects, allowing employees to grow their knowledge and experience and EDGE to provide the best solutions to our customers.
  • Engaging Projects. The diverse needs of our clients ensure your work is always of interest and provide opportunities for innovation at every level of the company. Our employees enjoy greater responsibility and develop a breadth of experience not common with other entry- to mid-level career opportunities in our field.
  • Career Growth Opportunities. At least one member of our corporate leadership is involved in every major project, allowing for a close relationship between management and employees. We encourage collaboration and ingenuity and reward success by promoting from within.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan. We offer a full suite of benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, retirement savings plans with employer contributions, paid time off and more. Enjoy a career that also offers peace of mind when you join the EDGE team.

Benefits

EDGE places high value on the health and well-being of its employees and offers the following benefits:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance.
  • Employer matched 401(k) plan.
  • Annual performance bonus program.
  • Student loan repayment assistance after 12 months of employment for employees who graduated within 6 years of start date.
  • Competitive maternity leave.

Please note: EDGE will not sponsor an employment visa (e.g., H‐1B visa, OPT, etc.) to fill this position.

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive, and trustworthy Executive Assistant to provide administrative and personal business support to a busy business owner. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can confidently manage multiple priorities, and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks without needing constant direction. You’ll support the executive across both business and personal administrative responsibilities, helping to keep their schedule, inbox, business interests, and day-to-day organisation running smoothly. The role will initially be 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to full-time as the relationship develops and the business’s needs grow.
Key Responsibilities
● Manage and organise the executive's inbox and emails
● Prioritise emails, flag important messages, and help ensure timely responses
● Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, and scheduling
● Coordinate business and personal travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, transportation, and itineraries
● Provide general administrative support across multiple business entities
● Assist with the administration and organisation of rental properties
● Maintain organised digital files, records, and important documentation
● Prepare, format, and edit professional documents, reports, and presentations
● Conduct online research and compile information when required
● Coordinate appointments, bookings, and other personal or business arrangements
● Help manage and track ongoing tasks, deadlines, and priorities
● Liaise with clients, suppliers, contractors, and other contacts professionally
● Anticipate administrative needs and proactively take care of tasks before they become issues
● Provide general executive and personal administrative support as required

Requirements

    ● Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar administrative role
    ● Excellent organisational and time-management skills
    ● Strong written and verbal English
    ● Exceptional attention to detail
    ● Confident managing a busy inbox and calendar
    ● Experience arranging travel and coordinating schedules
    ● Strong document formatting and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace skills
    ● Comfortable managing confidential and sensitive information
    ● Ability to manage multiple priorities across different businesses and projects
    ● Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    ● Proactive approach with the ability to work independently
    ● Reliable, resourceful, and comfortable working remotely

The Ideal Candidate

    We're looking for someone who can become a trusted right hand to the executive.
    You should be naturally organised, highly dependable, and someone who doesn't wait to be told
    what needs doing. You'll need to be comfortable switching between business administration,
    personal organisation, travel arrangements, property-related tasks, and ad-hoc requests
    throughout the day.
    The successful candidate will have excellent judgement, strong attention to detail, and the ability
    to anticipate what the executive needs next.

100% REMOTE

Our team includes engineers, developers, architects, and problem-solvers who work alongside federal partners such as DHS, DOJ, and DOD, as well as select commercial clients, to deliver solutions that matter.

We focus on modernizing complex environments by automating infrastructure, improving security, enabling cloud-native operations, applying DevSecOps practices, and helping organizations make smarter use of their data. Our work spans everything from enterprise architecture to AI/ML implementations and identity management, giving our clients practical solutions and clear paths forward.

We also put a lot of care into how we work. Via Logic values flexibility, collaboration, and a people-first culture that supports work-life balance and gives our team the space to do meaningful, high-impact work—wherever mission needs take us.

About the Role:We’re looking for an immensely talented Solution Architect to join our growing team! This architect will have advanced expertise in cloud architecture, data analytics, data modeling, machine learning, security, and emerging cloud-native technologies.

As a key member of our team, you will support product teams in migrating, modernizing, automating, and innovating applications. The role demands strong technical skills to architect, design, develop, and engineer complex projects that deliver business value and strategic insights.

**Candidates must meet public trust clearance requirements

Basic Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 11 years of relevant experience in enterprise software architecture, analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence or a similar role.
  • Proven track record of delivering impactful emerging technology value including AI/ML/NLP innovations and data-driven solutions in a cloud native environment.
  • MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN AND RESIDE IN THE U.S. All work must be performed in the U.S.
  • Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Public Trust U.S. citizenship is mandatory, as this work is for a federal government client. Candidates will need to successfully complete a Background Investigation (BI) and credit check prior to beginning work. Nothing in applicants’ history should prevent them from obtaining a public trust security clearance.

Technical and Skills Requirements:

  • 10+ years of relevant Solution Architect experience
  • Software development methodology: DevSecOps with Rally, Automated Deployment pipelines with Git/GitLab, SonarQube, Nexus.
  • Programming Languages: Python, R, SQL. AI, ML, NLP Frameworks, models, and tools.
  • Data Manipulation & Analysis: visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI.
  • Big Data & Cloud Platforms: Hadoop, Hive, AWS (S3, SageMaker, Redshift), Azure, and GCP.
  • Infrastructure: AWS (Primary cloud): Azure and Google Cloud Platforms.
  • Innovative Problem Solving & Project Management: Tackle complex challenges with creative solutions and a proactive approach to process improvement. Proven successful track record working in an agile environment. Excel in managing multiple projects with innovative, prioritized strategies.
  • Dynamic Teamwork & Agile Expertise: Thrive in collaborative environments with strong communication and Agile software engineering skills.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Government sector experience, especially with DHS
  • Current holder of public trust clearance.
  • AWS Certification such as Certified Solutions Architect/DevOps Engineer
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Developer
  • Terraform Certified Associate

Role Responsibilities:

  • Architect, build, and deploy pilots, prototypes, and proof-of-concept solutions to validate cloud-native innovations across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Develop automation, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Utilize containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and serverless architectures.
  • Ensure transparency, traceability, and security compliance, including Authorization To Operate certifications.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, product, and business teams to translate needs into technical solutions.
  • Design and implement predictive models, algorithms, and statistical analyses for complex business challenges.
  • Build scalable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure for model development, training, and deployment.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis to derive actionable insights from large, complex datasets.
  • Develop data management and governance plans.
  • Create reusable code libraries, SOPs, and best practices for modernization and automation.

Via Logic LLC Perks & Benefits:

raw.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.

Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company. We’ve recently been recognized on Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.

About the Role

As a Key Account Executive focused on Aerospace & Defense, you'll own and grow some of CoLab’s most strategic enterprise accounts across North America. You’ll engage with senior engineering, program, and procurement leaders at large A&D companies, closing enterprise deals ranging from $200K to $2M+, and uncovering opportunities to expand across business units and global programs.

This is a high-impact role for a consultative, relationship-driven seller who understands the complexity of regulated industries and thrives in long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales. You’ll play a key role in shaping CoLab’s presence in the A&D market, bringing valuable insights from the field back into our GTM and product strategy.

This position will require occasional travel for on-site team meetings in Newfoundland Canada, at least twice per year (primarily in December and June) in addition to occasional travel to customer sites. We recognize that travel can involve personal commitments, and we strive to accommodate individual circumstances, however the expectation is that travel to, and attendance at, the majority of these events is mandatory. Details about travel arrangements and covered expenses will be discussed during the hiring process.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for CoLab’s largest Aerospace & Defense accounts across North America.
  • Close high-value enterprise deals ($200K–$2M+), navigating complex buying processes with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead in-depth discovery conversations to understand engineering workflows, regulatory constraints, and program pressures.
  • Partner with Sales Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to drive high-quality engagement and expansion across enterprise accounts.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with engineering, operations, and procurement leaders within target A&D organizations.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor—articulating how CoLab can help reduce rework, accelerate time-to-market, and improve design quality across the product lifecycle.
  • Develop strategic account and territory plans for large enterprise A&D organizations.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline and accurate forecasting using Salesforce.
  • Collaborate on contract renewals and expansion motions to grow customer lifetime value (CLV) over time.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales with a proven track record of closing high-value contracts (ranging from $200K to $2M+).
  • Experience selling into large organizations (10,000+ employees) and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Familiarity with selling into Aerospace & Defense, or similar sectors such as defense tech, aviation, industrial systems, or manufacturing.
  • Strong consultative selling and solution-based approach, particularly in industries like industrial equipment, automotive, aerospace, or similar highly technical sectors.
  • Ability to manage a growing pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, ensuring effective follow-up and timely progression of deals.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: Ability to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles and align internal resources to close deals.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade senior decision-makers in large organizations.
  • Experience using Salesforce to manage pipeline and forecast deals with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate across departments to ensure alignment on customer needs and business objectives.
  • Self-motivated and driven to exceed sales targets and grow enterprise accounts.

raw.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Own the Judgment Calls That Keep Orders Moving

Every shipment eventually hits a moment that isn't in the SOP — a failed carrier connection, an oversized load with no obvious coverage, a customer who needs a straight answer under pressure. As an Operations Specialist II, you're the person who resolves that moment without waiting for someone else to tell you how.

You've mastered the OS I fundamentals and are now trusted to act on incomplete information, source coverage other people can't, and de-escalate situations independently. This is where reactive execution starts becoming proactive ownership.

What You'll Do

Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist I job description, in addition to the following:

Resolve What Doesn't Fit the Standard Playbook

  • Independently start carrier traces for failed-to-load or unable-to-locate shipments
  • Source driver coverage for any segment of an order, including oversized shipments
  • Use bid/quote request tools to source specialized vehicles and provide cost estimates to customers
  • Apply training and tenured knowledge to anticipate complications and proactively solve for them

Exercise Independent Judgment

  • De-escalate most situations without assistance
  • Know when to escalate an order versus independently resolving it using available resources
  • Understand the downstream impact of decisions made within an order

Communicate Proactively and Strengthen the Platform

  • Communicate proactively — not just reactively — with customers, drivers, and agents at every step of the shipment process
  • Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements
  • Identify and suggest system features or workflow improvements that would help Operations

Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance

As an OS II, you'll be expected to meet minimum metric requirements and customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor. Expectations increase with each advancement.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist I, or equivalent time-critical logistics / customer operations experience
  • Proven ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and under time pressure
  • Track record of de-escalating difficult customer or operational situations without needing to hand it off
  • Comfort sourcing non-standard solutions (specialized vehicles, oversized loads) rather than defaulting to escalation
  • Any certifications required for your assigned sector (e.g., Dangerous Goods handling, where applicable), or willingness to obtain them
  • Continued availability to work the shift pattern required by your team
  • Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

Advancement to Operations Specialist III

To advance to OS III, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

  • Minimum of 6-12 months in the OS II role
  • Consistently meeting or exceeding OS II performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
  • Demonstrated advanced problem-solving proficiency — independently resolving escalations rather than routing them upward
  • Working understanding of margin and cost tradeoffs as they relate to order decisions
  • Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as an escalation point for the team

Compensation

  • Hourly pay range: $23-26/hr
  • High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
  • 401K company contribution program
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at before responding.

Preferred Qualifications:

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $100,900.00 to $148,100.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

raw.excerpt: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable.
raw.description:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

As our PR & Brand Manager (Maternity Cover), you’ll own the day-to-day relationship with our PR agencies across six markets, drive pan-European PR coordination across all our markets, and lead our brand tracking and PR research initiatives. Reporting to our Lead Brand Communications, you’ll be the go-to person for PR excellence, working cross-functionally with Marketing, Supply, Data and other teams to bring refurbed’s brand story to life across Europe.

This is a fixed-term, 18-month contract covering a maternity leave.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • You have 2-4 years of experience in PR, communications or brand roles, including experience owning relationships with PR agencies or external partners across multiple markets.
  • You have highly professional written and spoken English, plus fluency in another major European language (Swedish is a strong plus, given the content and market responsibilities of this role).
  • You can be based remotely anywhere in Europe; occasional travel to our markets and events is part of the role. Our Vienna HQ is available if you’d prefer to be based there.
  • You take ownership end-to-end: you’re used to running a project or subarea on your own, and you don’t wait to be told what’s next — you spot gaps, improve ways of working, and raise the quality of what’s around you.
  • You build strong cross-functional relationships; people come to you for PR and brand input because they trust your judgment and expertise.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable juggling multiple markets, agencies and stakeholders without losing sight of deadlines.
  • You have a strong feel for written language and tone, and experience translating data and company priorities into external-facing stories.
  • You have experience working with AI tools and are open to learning more about implementing AI into your daily work
  • You’re passionate about sustainability, innovation and creating real impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

PR Agency & Market Management:

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with PR agencies across SE, DK, FI, IE, BE and NL, including briefing, approving PR materials, developing local angles and following up on performance/KPIs.
  • Act as the main internal point of contact for these markets, ensuring agencies have the information, data and materials they need.

Pan-European PR Coordination:

  • Own and host the monthly editorial meeting across 16 PR agencies/markets, including agenda, preparation, follow-up and continuous improvement of the format.
  • Drive cross-market sharing of PR ideas, opportunities and best practices.
  • Manage the press pages across all markets, ensuring the latest press releases and relevant content are published and kept up to date.

Data, Research & Brand Tracking:

  • Source and analyse internal data for PR stories, identify relevant trends and coordinate internal data validation.
  • Own the refurbed brand tracker, including planning waves, managing research, setting up surveys and reporting results.
  • Manage PR consumer studies across markets, coordinating agency input, developing and delivering results and insights.

Content & Language Support:

  • Proofread and adapt content for Performance Marketing, CRM and other teams.
  • Review and approve UGC/performance content.

Events & Activations:

  • Plan and manage PR and influencer events, including concept, budget, agency coordination, internal stakeholders, products and logistics.
  • Represent refurbed at events, including presentations/keynotes, and manage post-event reporting.

PR Project & Stakeholder Management:

  • Manage PR projects from idea to execution, translating company priorities, data and initiatives into relevant external communications.
  • Coordinate across PR agencies and internal teams including Marketing, Supply, Data and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution.

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

  • Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!
  • We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.
  • You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!
  • No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

  • You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.
  • We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.
  • We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

  • We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊
  • We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.
  • You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See for further insights!

About Sports Info Solutions

Pioneers in the Sports Data Industry

SIS was founded on the belief that decision making in sports could be improved and that we could help teams win more games through the use of better data, analytics, and technology.

That belief has been validated repeatedly since our founding in 2002 as we continue to revolutionize the way the game is played, both on and off the field.

Company overview

Our mission is to enrich and optimize the decision-making process for sports teams, sportsbooks, and sports fans.

We are proud to be a leader in collecting, analyzing and distributing the deepest data sets and insights to professional sports teams across the MLB, NBA and NFL.

We are now doubling down on what’s made us successful by further advancing our data, technology, insights and partners as we drive forward the next innovations in Sports Data and Analytics.

Position overview

Sports Info Solutions (SIS) is looking for a new team member to fill a full-time position in our tech department as a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer.

Sports Info Solutions is seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer for a remote role to architect robust software solutions, lead technical initiatives, and mentor engineering talent. This position will focus on building scalable APIs, delivering exceptional frontend experiences, and driving technical vision from conception to deployment to support our high-performing engineering culture and complex customer needs.

What you’ll do as Senior Full Stack Software Engineer on the team at SIS:

Includes (but is not limited to):

  • Technical Leadership & Team Management: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, guide technical strategy, and take on direct team management responsibilities to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • System Architecture & Backend Scale: Architect and develop highly scalable APIs and software solutions tailored to the complex needs of SIS customers like NFL front offices, MLB analytics teams, NBA decision-makers, and Sportsbooks serving millions of customers.
  • Frontend Excellence: Lead the creation of robust front ends, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and optimal client-side performance, to bring designs to life in the browser with slick user experiences.
  • Strategic Impact: Build and launch new capabilities and products that translate to wins on the field and dollars for our partners, driving technical vision from conception to deployment.
  • Process & Code Ownership: Lead software design planning, conduct rigorous code reviews, and drive the product development lifecycle.
  • Engineering Standards: Define, implement, and uphold our high engineering standards, architecting systems that constantly elevate code quality across the entire organization by designing efficient, reusable, testable, and reliable code.

Why work with SIS?

We believe in making sports better through data, analysis and insights. For that reason, we have an incredible team of technologists, scouts, analysts, and operators helping our partners win more games.

It is our ultimate vision to create an unparalleled platform of sporting data and insights, through best-in-class technology, products and partnerships.

We believe in a flexible, energetic, enjoyable working environment where we band together as teammates to do great things. We are committed to creating a diverse environment, working in a collaborative, team-centric environment.

Qualifications

If you possess the following, you are well on your way to making an impact at SIS:

  • Significant prior success as a Software Engineer working on challenging problems at an enterprise scale.
  • Extensive experience with modern JavaScript/Typescript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js) as well as Object-Oriented languages like C# or Java.
  • Demonstrated experience, or a highly motivated desire, to lead, manage, and mentor a team of software engineers.
  • A deep understanding of the Web combined with advanced familiarity with REST design principles.
  • Extensive experience architecting relational databases and a high comfort level with complex SQL.
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing against third-party APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to not only deliver software as part of a team, but to communicate across teams to define project roadmaps and meet critical deadlines.
  • A champion for code reviews/pull requests who has consistently shown a dedication to well-documented code and Engineering processes.

Nice to have, but not required qualifications

These skills will set you apart:

  • Deep expertise in designing and implementing service-oriented architecture (SOA).
  • Advanced familiarity with a cloud computing environment such as Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Specific expertise with Vue.js and ASP.NET Core.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests for enterprise systems.
  • Mastery of cross-browser compatibility, responsive design, website performance, and accessibility.
  • Passion for sports and/or the sports betting space.

EEO commitment

SIS provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, veteran status, military status, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition to federal law requirements, SIS complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Abilities required

These physical demands are representative of the physical requirements necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation can be made to enable people with disabilities to perform the described essential functions of the job.

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, including intensive computer usage.

Additional info

Sponsorship is not available for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The salary range is $105,000 to $135,000.

Sports Info Solutions uses E-Verify and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist

Remote | Gastroenterology | Part-Time, 40 hours/week | Rate: $6.5/hour

About the Role

This Gastroenterology practice is looking for a highly organized, patient-focused Bilingual Medical Scheduling & Patient Support Specialist to support its clinics in two locations in Texas.

This role is heavily focused on appointment scheduling and patient communication, with a high daily call volume of approximately 70 to 90 calls per day. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment, managing multiple communication channels, and maintaining accurate patient documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Appointment Scheduling

  • Handle approximately 70 to 90 inbound and outbound calls daily related to appointments for the Lewisville and Denton locations.

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments while ensuring accurate and timely communication with patients.

  • Maintain and update provider schedules in RingCentral and eClinicalWorks (eCW) based on availability and scheduling requirements.

2. Fax Management

  • Send and receive faxes involving patient records, referrals, insurance documents, and other clinical or administrative information.

  • Review incoming fax communications and route documents to the appropriate provider, department, or patient record.

  • Accurately log, upload, and organize faxed documentation within the clinic's systems.

3. Language Interpretation Support

  • Provide occasional language interpretation assistance between patients and clinic staff when needed.

  • Help ensure medical and administrative information is communicated clearly and accurately across language barriers.

  • Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and accuracy when assisting with patient-provider communication.

4. Outbound Calling

  • Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, follow-ups, patient updates, and care coordination.

  • Contact insurance companies, referring providers, pharmacies, or other healthcare offices when necessary.

  • Document call outcomes, follow-up requirements, and relevant information accurately in the patient's record.

5. Patient Text Messaging

  • Send appointment confirmations, reminders, updates, and other approved patient communications through text messaging.

  • Monitor and collect patient responses and escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate clinic team member when needed.

  • Document relevant text conversations and patient responses in RingCentral and eCW to maintain continuity of care.

6. Billing and Payment Reminder Support

  • Contact patients regarding outstanding balances, billing reminders, or upcoming payment obligations as instructed by the clinic.

  • Provide basic payment-related information and direct patients to the appropriate billing resource when additional assistance is required.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical administration, medical virtual assistance, patient scheduling, front desk support, or a similar healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable handling a high-volume call environment, including approximately 70 to 90 calls per day.

  • Experience using eClinicalWorks (eCW) and RingCentral is highly preferred.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills with a professional and patient-friendly approach.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and ability to manage multiple tasks throughout the workday.

  • Experience supporting a gastroenterology or specialty medical practice is an advantage.

  • Ability to communicate in an additional language and provide interpretation support is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is confident speaking with patients throughout the day, comfortable managing a high volume of appointments and communications, and able to stay organized while supporting two clinic locations. You should be dependable, detail-oriented, professional, and capable of providing a positive patient experience while maintaining accurate documentation.
